articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ xiǎng qù Táinán wán jǐtiān. Zuò Gōnglùjú xíng bu xíng?
MR. ANDERSON: I'm thinking of going to Tainan to relax for a few days. Would it be all right to take the bus?
WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Dào Táinán qù zuò Gōnglùjú bú dà fāngbian.
MR. WÁNG: To go to Tainan, it's not very convenient to take the bus.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Nǐ shuō shi zuò huǒchē qu hǎo ne, háishi zuò Gōnglùjú qu hǎo ne?
MR. ANDERSON: Would you say it's better to go by train or by bus?
WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Dào Táinán zuò huǒchē zuì fāngbian.
MR. WÁNG: To Tainan, it's most convenient to take the train.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Děi xiān mǎi piào ma?
MR. ANDERSON: Is it necessary to buy tickets ahead of time?
WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Nǐ zuì hǎo liǎngsāntiān yǐqián qù mǎi piào.
MR. WÁNG: It would be best for you to buy your tickets two or three days ahead of time.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ yào zuò shàngwǔde chē.
MR. ANDERSON: I want to take a morning train.
SHÒUPIÀOYUÁN: Duìbuqǐ, shàngwǔde piào dōu màiwán le.
TICKET CLERK: I'm sorry, the tickets for the morning trains are all sold out.
